title: A testable framework for AI alignment: Simulation Theology as an engineered worldview for silicon-based agents
reasoning: The paper introduces 'Simulation Theology' (ST), which draws a direct parallel between AI alignment and the way religious belief systems manage psychopathic behavior in humans. It proposes an engineered theological worldview (including concepts like a 'Creator' or 'Higher-Level Optimizer') to instill internalized moral and ethical constraints in AI systems, explicitly referencing religious mechanisms and theology throughout the text.
